title: Minecraft Dream Anime Sky
description: Transform your Minecraft sky into a breathtaking anime landscape with vibrant colors and fluffy, painted clouds.
body: Anime Dream Sky completely transforms the default Minecraft sky, bringing a cinematic, painterly aesthetic to your world. Enjoy breathtaking, fluffy clouds and warm pastel gradients.✨ Key Features:Aesthetic Sky: Gorgeous custom clouds with a hand-painted anime look.Cinematic Vibe: Warm tones that bring a cozy and magical feel to your game.FPS Friendly: Optimized textures that won't lag your game.⚙️ Requirements:To load the custom sky properly, you will need OptiFine OR the Iris + FabricSkyBoxes mod combination. Make sure "Custom Sky" is enabled in your video settings.
